title: Seven Ashina Spears - Shume Masaji Oniwa

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Seven Ashina Spears - Shume Masaji Oniwa (葦名七本槍 鬼庭主馬雅次, Seven Spears of Ashina Oniwa Shume Masaji) is an optional Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
As the Tenth Prayer Necklace states, the Seven Ashina Spears are Isshin's most loyal samurai who helped his rise to power.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Ashina Reservoir: during the final invasion of Ashina Castle by the Central Forces, just past the Sculptor's Idol, accompanied by an Ashina Samurai.

sections.heading: Eavesdropping
sections.text:
Shume Masaji Oniwa: ... Did you kill them all?
Ashina Samurai: I did...
Shume Masaji Oniwa: Good... We will begin when Lord Genichiro returns. ... We will revive Ashina together with the Dragon's Blood.
Ashina Samurai: Yes...
